buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at

the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Procuring Institution: Government College of Engineering and Technology (GCET), Safapora, Ganderbal, J& K. Buyer Added Text-Based ATC Clauses 1. Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF): The bidder shall submit an ink-signed MAF issued by the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), authorizing the bidder to supply the offered laptop model. 2. OEM Compliance Certificate: The bidder shall submit an ink-signed technical compliance certificate on the official OEM letterhead, authenticated by the Area Sales Manager (ASM) – Kashmir, confirming that the off ered laptop meets all required specifications. 3. Seller Support in the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir: The bidder shall have an established service/sup port arrangement within the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir for providing warranty coordination, trou bleshooting and after-sales support. The bidder shall provide details of the service/support facility, includin g address, contact person, telephone number and email ID. The Purchaser may verify the support arrange ment before award of contract. 4. Shops and Establishments Certificate: The bidder shall submit a valid Shops and Establishments Certificate , wherever applicable. 5. Non-Blacklisting Certificate: The bidder shall submit a signed certificate declaring that the firm has not bee n blacklisted or debarred by any Government Department or public authority. 6. ISO Certification: Both the bidder and the OEM shall submit valid ISO certificates relevant to their respectiv e activities. 7. TCO and TÜV Certification: The bidder shall submit valid TCO Certified and TÜV certification documents ap plicable to the offered laptop model. 8. Certificate of Incorporation: The bidder shall submit a Certificate of Incorporation or other applicable docu ment as proof of the firm's legal constitution. 9. Technical Specifications: The offered laptop must meet all specifications mentioned in the GeM bid. The bi dder shall submit the official OEM datasheet or product brochure. 10.

Product Condition: The laptops supplied must be brand-new, genuine and unused. Refurbished or second- hand products shall not be accepted. 11. Warranty and Service: The laptops shall carry the OEM warranty as specified in the bid. The bidder shall pr ovide warranty documents and details of authorized service support. 12. Delivery and Inspection: The bidder shall deliver the laptops within the specified period. The supplied item s shall be checked for quantity, specifications, condition and accessories before acceptance. 13. Verification and Rejection: All submitted documents must be genuine, valid and verifiable. The purchaser may reject a bid for false documents, failure to meet essential requirements or non-compliance with the bi d conditions, as permitted under applicable GeM rules. 14. General Conditions: The bidder shall comply with the GeM General Terms and Conditions and all applicable Government procurement rules. Note: All required documents shall be uploaded with the bid. Certification and authorization requirements shall be applicable to the offered model and subject to the relevant GeM procurement rules. . 3. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support.
